A '''cave slime''' is a [[Slayer]] monster found on all of [[Daemonheim]]'s floors. They require level 17 [[Slayer]] to kill. They are the only monsters that can drop the special [[Incantor's boots]] and [[Sorcerer's boots]]. Unlike the cave slime found in the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]] and [[Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon]], these monsters are not poisonous.
